## Engineering problem

Validating optical modules with cosmic-ray muons requires turning raw multi-channel PMT waveforms into per-PMT and per-module performance figures, with event selection that separates muon coincidences from single-photon noise.

## Architecture

- `util/` — reusable modules for reading HDF5 data, event histograms and plotting.
- `tools/` — numbered analysis entry points, from data inspection and quick checks through muon coincidence selection, full muon analysis, PMT characterization and charge-correlation plots.

## Functionality

- Waveform processing and charge integration.
- Coincidence-based muon event selection.
- PMT- and module-level performance characterization.
- Cross-checks of detector stability and response uniformity.
- Figure generation for validation and reporting.

## Tools and technologies

Python (≥ 3.10), NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, h5py; HDF5 input files.

## Data availability and limitations

The repository contains code only. Raw IceCube detector data, internal calibration files and collaboration-restricted resources are excluded, and users must supply their own data in a compatible HDF5 format. The code is not an official IceCube software product.
